== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Eclipse, also known as the [[Ancient Bow of the Soulseeker]] or the [[sacred bow|Sacred Bow of the Soulseeker]], is a powerful weapon wielded by [[Mercy]]. The bow was previously owned by her mother, who used it during her journey from [[Lowgold]] to [[Archlord]] and utilized the weapon to seal the Shara Kahn volcano. It is constructed from the remnant of a [[Shadow|shadow]] dragon that attained the status of a [[Sage]]. The weapon features a dragon's head at its center with blazing eyes, and it is capable of instantly producing hundreds of violet or amethyst light arrows. When used, the bow can release dark [[madra]] that spreads across a target like living ropes.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Eclipse is an Ancient [[Bow]] belonging to the Soulseeker that possesses the ability to forge arrows of jet-black energy. Crafted from the remnant of a [[Shadow|shadow]] dragon that ascended to become a [[Sage]], the weapon served [[Mercy]]'s mother throughout her journey from [[Lowgold]] to [[Archlord]]. During her tenure, [[Mercy]]'s mother utilized the bow to successfully seal the living volcano of Shara Kahn. [[Mercy]] now carries the weapon and affectionately refers to it as [[Suu]].}}
